remarks: Experience the best of downtown Greenwich living in this distinct one-bedroom condo at Fairfield House. Ideally situated at the top of Greenwich Avenue, this first-floor unit offers unparalleled access to fine dining, boutique shopping, and Greenwich Hospital. The unit features an open floor plan and ample natural light. Residents enjoy free outdoor parking and the option of a heated underground garage for a monthly fee. Additional amenities include an elevator and conveniently located lower-level laundry facilities and an individual storage unit. Come see why Fairfield House is the perfect place to call home!
